incomePathways.counterfactual: Existing legal aid, public contracts, alternative providers and benefit payments continue. Capacity b once; legal-payment additionality a only on positive conversion cohort. Full access burden on all funding-responsive households.
incomePathways.rationale: One-time settlement/benefit recovery distributed across judgment household-equivalents. Retention, baseline, burden and overlap are hypotheses, not observed client net cash. No recurring annual stock, gross wages or retail housing value.
